svg.aria-label: Weeks of cover for one style over nine weeks, calculated two ways. On a four-week rate of sale cover rises from 4.8 to 10.1 weeks. On a season-to-date rate of sale it stays flat between 4.8 and 3.8 weeks.

svg.text: Weeks of cover for one style. The two methods agree in week 4 and part from week 5.
